name: render_vega
description: Show a chart drawn from a Vega-Lite spec. Give the rows inline as data.values (at most 5000), never a URL; use one y axis and at most 8 colours, and pick the chart for the question: sorted bars to compare, a line for change over time, stacked bars for parts of a whole. The spec is checked and compiled before it is shown: the chat app draws it live, a channel such as WhatsApp gets it as a picture, and the picture is kept in the workspace under charts/. A spec that breaks a rule or doesn't compile is refused with one line per problem: fix them and call again. After it, say in one line what the chart shows; don't repeat its numbers. Only shows it; there is no reply.

spec.description: The Vega-Lite spec: data.values (the rows), mark and encoding; every field it encodes is in the rows

title.description: What the chart shows, in a few words, e.g. Spending this month
